dashManualHelp.message: Create generates a new short URL for the target. To change an existing link, select Edit beside a link in a list or use Check YOURLS to find it, then select Update existing link. Changes can affect links already shared.

dashEditReady.message: Existing link selected. Use Update existing link to change its destination.

dashNotFound.message: No existing short URL found. You can generate one.

bulkExplanation.message: Paste one full HTTP(S) URL per line. Existing YOURLS links will be reused. Up to 250 unique URLs per run.

logExplanation.message: Local log of the last seven days (maximum 100 entries). No API tokens, email contents or URLs are recorded.

optionsShortcutSentence.message: Select a URL in a message you are writing, then press $shortcut$.

optionsPrivacyNotice.message: kURL sends the URL you choose to shorten or manage, and optional keywords/titles, to your configured HTTPS YOURLS server. API signatures are time-limited; your raw token and seven-day activity log stay in local browser storage. No data is sent to the add-on developer.

keywordAdjusted.message: YOURLS changed the requested keyword; check the returned short URL.

confirmUpdate.message: Update this existing YOURLS short URL? Its target or keyword may already be referenced on websites or in sent emails.

confirmRegenerate.message: Regenerate this short URL? Changing the keyword can break existing links on websites and in sent emails.

confirmDelete.message: Delete this short URL permanently? Existing websites and sent emails may refer to it.

dashSelectToEdit.message: Select an existing short URL and enter its target.

optionsShortcutUnassigned.message: No shortcut assigned. Choose one with Configure shortcuts or use the toolbar button.

helperSetupSummary.message: The optional Helper runs on your YOURLS server, not in this browser extension.

helperInstructions.message: Installation guide, source code and download

helperStep1.message: Download plugin.php below, or copy its complete PHP source code.

helperStep2.message: On the YOURLS server create user/plugins/kurl-helper/ and save the file as plugin.php (not plugin.php.txt).

helperStep3.message: Open YOURLS administration → Manage Plugins and activate kURL Helper.

helperStep4.message: Return to the kURL dashboard and select Refresh. Version 1.1.6 or newer enables advanced actions.

helperSource.message: View the Helper source in this project on GitHub

helperSafety.message: One YOURLS Helper installation works with multiple kURL clients. Changing or deleting links can break URLs already shared on websites or in sent emails.

optionsOpenDashboardHint.message: Open Dashboard in its own tab to manage short links and view optional Helper setup instructions.

optionsStatusNotSaved.message: Connection failed. Settings were not saved.

optionsStatusSavedUnchecked.message: Settings saved without connection verification. You can test the connection later.

helperCopyDone.message: The complete plugin.php source was copied.

helperDownloadStarted.message: Download requested. Save the file as plugin.php.

optionsCopyFeedbackHint.message: Display brief copy confirmations in the dashboard and feedback after right-click copying or inserting. Turning this off hides success toasts, desktop notifications and badges; errors remain visible. Saved immediately.

apiAuthRejected.message: YOURLS rejected the API signature. An update may have changed your token. Sign in to the YOURLS admin area in a web browser, open Admin → Tools, copy the current API signature to kURL Settings, then choose Test connection & save. No username or password is needed in kURL. If it still fails, check your computer and server clocks and any API access rules.

apiAccessDenied.message: The server refused API access (HTTP 401/403). Check the API signature in YOURLS Admin → Tools and test again. If it is current, check your server's access restrictions and clocks. kURL does not sign in to the admin interface.

apiInvalidResponse.message: YOURLS did not return a valid API response (HTTP $status$). Check the server URL, HTTPS and any proxy or login redirect.

apiOpenTools.message: Open YOURLS Admin → Tools to copy the current API signature
